task_instance: Run the no-connector fallback path end-to-end for a small gym owner (Kettlebell & Co): build a voice profile from sample past posts/newsletter/interview notes, hold a standing content calendar (Path column, all Text since no Shopify/Canva/HubSpot/Notion/Trello/Mailchimp connectors exist in this sandbox), write 6 rows of on-voice captions (5 social + 1 email) anchored to the voice profile, and stage the social rows to a scheduling CSV for manual import (the documented fallback when HubSpot isn't connected), leaving the email row presented inline instead of staged, with everything staged/drafted rather than published.
evidence: Created sample-existing-posts.md (5 IG captions, 1 newsletter, interview notes) to stand in for the owner's real content. Built voice-profile.md by extracting tone rules, banned/preferred phrases, and structural patterns from that material. Built content-calendar.md with 6 rows, a Path column (all 'Text' since Shopify/Canva/HubSpot/Notion/Trello/Mailchimp connectors are all out of scope/unavailable in this sandbox per the safety rules), and a documented Home line, matching the skill's stated no-connector fallback ('drafts the calendar and asset briefs for manual posting'). Wrote captions.md with hook/benefit/CTA/hashtag-structured captions for the 5 social rows and a full subject+preheader+body email for the 1 email row, each checked against voice-profile.md's banned phrase list. Staged the 5 social rows into scheduling.csv (Date,Time,Channel,Caption,Hashtags,Status). Verified programmatically with a python3 script (run in scheduling.csv's directory): all 5 CSV rows parse as valid CSV, all 5 dates are after today (2026-09-27), no banned marketing phrases ('exciting news','thrilled','game-changer', etc.) appear in any caption, and the Email row is correctly absent from scheduling.csv (left inline in captions.md per the skill's rule that email is never auto-staged). Output files in the work directory: sample-existing-posts.md, voice-profile.md, content-calendar.md, captions.md, scheduling.csv, final-summary.md. No MCP/connector tools were called; the design-generation (Canva), Shopify pull, and HubSpot/Notion/Trello staging paths were correctly not attempted since those connectors are unavailable/forbidden here, and the skill explicitly documents a manual/text-only fallback for exactly this situation, which is what was executed and verified.
